title: Pre-publication QA. Missing context.
summary: Four-second deletion recovered and inspected side by side.
narration: The edited highlight runs fourteen seconds. The raw recording runs eighteen. What is missing? A team about to publish a benchmark demo needs that answer first, so it checks what the edit removed.

title: Deterministic alignment first.
summary: Raw vs. highlight comparison; measured correspondence establishes matches.
narration: CONTEXT lines the two recordings up and finds a gap: four seconds, from six to ten. It found the cut by matching the audio. Matching the picture alone wasn't enough on this clip. The boundary error against the known cut is zero seconds.

title: Synchronized feeds & 'WARM CACHE' reveal.
summary: Dual-player shows the removed seconds; Muse reads the matched interval (saved response).
narration: Both players move together. Click the finding, and the raw recording plays the missing four seconds. On screen there: warm cache only, cold-start setup excluded, cold setup zero point eight three milliseconds. The edit's sampled frames show only generic conditions. Meta's Muse Spark 1.2 reads an excerpt around that matched interval. Alignment and crop measurement are deterministic. Muse notes that the removed seconds coincide with the warm-cache-only qualification. If that qualification is missing, it says the zero point zero zero nine microsecond figure could read as a general, end-to-end speedup. It reports inconclusive. Saved response, not run live. The human decides.

title: Geometric crop.
summary: Measured crop calipers (OpenCV geometry); SAM does not appear.
narration: Separately, a crop-detection fixture shows a frame cropped from twelve eighty by seven twenty to nine sixty by seven twenty. That's a quarter of the picture, removed from the right side, measured with OpenCV geometry.

title: Frozen benchmark evaluation.
summary: 15/15 intervals recovered across 12 positive cases; 0 benign alarms.
narration: On a frozen set of thirty scripted edits, it found all fifteen removed intervals, with zero seconds of boundary error. It raised no alarm on eighteen harmless edits. These are scripted cuts of recordings we authored, not field footage.

title: The team decides.
summary: Limits disclosed: scripted cuts, saved Muse response.
narration: CONTEXT doesn't judge the cut. It shows the evidence, so the team decides before publishing.
